item.title: Pope Leo becomes first pontiff to vote in US general election
item.description: Vatican confirms the pope submitted a mail-in ballot in his native Chicago ahead of November 3 midterm elections

item.title: Fake polls expose vulnerabilities in US elections ahead of midterms
item.description: Fabricated surveys are adding to tensions in the country's increasingly polarised political environment.

item.title: Dog walker threatened with gun during ICE arrest in North Hollywood
item.description: Footage shows masked ICE agents pointing a handgun at a bystander walking his dogs as they arrest another man in the US.

item.title: Germany and France brace for protests on Halloween weekend
item.description: A wave of youth-led protests has swept Europe, with demonstrators denouncing rising prices and a lack of prospects.

item.title: Brazil summons Argentinian diplomat over Bolsonaro’s flight to US
item.description: The move threatens to further strain relations between Brazilian President Lula and his Argentinian counterpart, Milei.

item.title: Iran war live: Oil tankers hit in Hormuz; Trump says conflict will end soon
item.description: IRGC says four tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz, as Trump says war on Iran will 'get wrapped up soon'.

item.title: Fans voice support on final night of Macklemore’s ‘Free Palestine’ tour
item.description: Al Jazeera spoke to fans attending Macklemore’s ‘Free Palestine’ concert after he was dropped from Ed Sheeran’s tour.

item.title: Polish police deployed to top court after head judge suspended
item.description: Judge's suspension is part of a long dispute over politicisation of the Constitutional Tribunal under former government.

item.title: Why AI could threaten much of the world’s digital infrastructure
item.description: Volunteer-led PHP, which powers most websites, is increasingly under threat from cyberattacks using AI capabilities.

item.title: US judge orders ethics inquiry into Trump lawyers over golf course case
item.description: Judge Ana Reyes calls on US government lawyers to explain contradictory statements about the East Potomac Golf Links.

item.title: Swiss supreme court upholds Liberian ex-rebel commander’s 20-year sentence
item.description: Alieu Kosiah killed civilians and unarmed soldiers, and ordered lootings and other crimes against humanity.

item.title: US appeals court again rejects Trump bid to set aside California ballots
item.description: The 9th Circuit Court calls the petition to remove 20,000 ballots from California's vote count unconstitutional.

item.title: G20 drops group photo as Europeans refuse to stand with Lavrov
item.description: Sanctioned Russian FM attends Atlanta talks as Iran war, Hormuz disruption and Ukraine divide G20 members.

item.title: Rubio hosts G20 talks as Russia’s Lavrov presence sparks tensions
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio urged G20 officials to work together to confront threats to the economic order.

item.title: Port Sudan families can barely afford water as shortages persist
item.description: Despite efforts to restore damaged infrastructure, residents face soaring water costs as war, displacement strain supply

item.title: EU and Canada seek deeper ties amid worsening global uncertainty
item.description: Both sides signed a digital trade deal, as Trump's trade threats push Washington's allies to seek closer ties elsewhere.

item.title: How 20-year-old Kimi Antonelli is making F1 history
item.description: Kimi Antonelli had an F1 licence before he could legally drive. Now he could become Formula One’s youngest champion.

item.title: What to know about California’s midterm elections
item.description: Redistricting in California, the most populous US state, could flip control of US House from Republican to Democrat.

item.title: Why is Netanyahu accusing Palestinian Israeli parties of fraud?
item.description: Prime Minister claims the parties accepted foreign funding.

item.title: Texas grand jury indicts ICE officer accused of running over man in Houston
item.description: The officer faces charges after allegedly striking a fleeing construction worker with an SUV during an immigration raid.

item.title: Pakistan army ‘cautiously optimistic’ about US-Iran mediation efforts
item.description: Pakistan's military spokesman warns of 'powerful spoilers and detractors' who still believe the conflict serves them.

item.title: Israel demolishes homes of Palestinians blamed for attack on soldiers
item.description: Troops hold at least 12 Palestinians near demolished homes as nearly 5,000 remain displaced from Hebron neighbourhoods

item.title: Oman rescues 25 from burning oil tanker in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Incident comes as Iran says three oil tankers were halted while attempting to use 'unauthorised routes' to cross Hormuz.

item.title: Kim Jong Un calls for North Korea’s drone technology superiority
item.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un calls for “absolute superiority” in drone capabilities.

item.title: How cuts under Colombia’s de la Espriella threaten a key human rights court
item.description: Colombia's president plans to slash spending on a transitional justice court. But war crimes victims fear the cost.
